authority.service: current User re-read; active status; MEMBER+; claim is_active/status/role/raw tenant/raw workspace in the admission transaction
authority.scope_policy: member same-workspace or legacy workspace-less; ADMIN+ cross-workspace in tenant; foreign tenant/workspace 404; unscoped platform actor keeps global-legacy policy

effect.claim: guarded AgentRegistry status -> running on exact id, tenant, workspace, name, description, capabilities, promotion floor, status, configuration and enabled
effect.job: AgentJob(id, tenant, agent_id, status=running, operation_id + parameters digest)
effect.receipt: one AuditLog action=agent_run_admitted in the same transaction
effect.dispatch: existing execute_agent_task only after commit, wrapped by a job lifecycle that marks running/success/failed and restores the prior agent status
effect.readback: job exists with the same operation id
effect.states: verified; already_applied; refused (404/400/403); conflict (409 STALE_TARGET/AUTHORITY_CHANGED/ALREADY_RUNNING/OPERATION_CONFLICT); not_applied (409); committed_unverified (503)

material.parameters: keyed digest only; raw parameters never enter the receipt or logs
material.replay: same operation/parameters -> already_applied; changed parameters -> OPERATION_CONFLICT

limits: process death between admission and dispatch leaves a running job/status; stale-job reconciliation is out of this slice
actual execution, model/provider calls, spend and external sends remain held separately
no new table or migration; PostgreSQL/soak and multi-worker remain unqualified
